title: Elder and the Three Cats
description: An elderly man in a purple beret and green jacket sits on a stone ledge, chin in hand, gazing at three cats. In the background, a desolate apocalyptic landscape features lightning strikes, dark smoke plumes, ruined towers, and two distant silhouetted figures shaking hands in the mist.
prompt: An elderly man wearing a purple beret and green jacket sits pensively on a stone ledge with his hand on his chin, looking at three realistic cats: a grey one, a brown tabby, and a green one. They are perched on the ledge looking back at him. Behind them stretches a barren wasteland under a stormy sky with dramatic purple lightning bolts striking down, plumes of dark smoke, and distant ruined towers. Two silhouetted men in hats are shaking hands in the foggy background, surreal ominous atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
